stem:
Sulfur trioxide, $\text{SO}_3$, is manufactured from sulfur dioxide and oxygen by the Contact process.
$$\text{2SO}_2\text{(g)} + \text{O}_2\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{2SO}_3\text{(g)} \quad \Delta H = -196.0\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: The enthalpy change of formation of $\text{SO}_2$, $\Delta H_{\text{f}} \text{SO}_2\text{(g)}$, is $-296.8\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$.
parts.text: Define the term *enthalpy change of formation*.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Use the data to calculate the enthalpy change of formation of $\text{SO}_3\text{(g)}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
The Contact process is usually carried out at a temperature of approximately $700\text{ K}$, a pressure of approximately $150\text{ kPa}$ and in the presence of a vanadium(V) oxide catalyst, $\text{V}_2\text{O}_5$.

{{figure:visual_auto_01.png}}
parts.text: Add a labelled mark, $Ea_{\text{uncat}}$, to the diagram to indicate the activation energy in the absence of the catalyst.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the benefit of using a catalyst in this reaction. Explain how it achieves this effect.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State and explain how an increase in pressure would affect both the rate of reaction and the yield of $\text{SO}_3$ in the Contact process.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
At a pressure of $1.50 \times 10^5\text{Pa}$, $1.00\text{ mol}$ of sulfur dioxide gas, $\text{SO}_2$, was mixed with $1.00\text{ mol}$ of oxygen gas, $\text{O}_2$. The final equilibrium mixture formed was found to contain $0.505\text{ mol}$ of $\text{O}_2$.
$$\text{2SO}_2\text{(g)} + \text{O}_2\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{2SO}_3\text{(g)}$$
parts.text: Calculate the amount, in mol, of $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{SO}_3$ in the equilibrium mixture.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the partial pressure of oxygen gas, $p\text{O}_2$, in the equilibrium mixture.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
In another equilibrium mixture formed from different starting amounts of $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$, the partial pressures of $\text{SO}_2$, $\text{O}_2$ and $\text{SO}_3$ were as shown.
$$p\text{SO}_2 = 8.42 \times 10^2\text{Pa}$$
$$p\text{O}_2 = 6.00 \times 10^4\text{Pa}$$
$$p\text{SO}_3 = 9.10 \times 10^4\text{Pa}$$
parts.text: Write the expression for the equilibrium constant, $K_p$, for the production of $\text{SO}_3$ from $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the value of $K_p$ for this reaction and state the units.
